summary.tldr: Bill S-3 changes rules for weights, measures, electricity and gas inspections, and gives the minister and inspectors new powers in some cases.
what_it_does: Clarifies the powers, duties and functions of the Minister of Industry and inspectors under the Weights and Measures Act.
Gives the Minister of Industry new powers, including sampling when devices are examined and ordering corrective or preventive measures.
Broadens the definition of “meter” under the Electricity and Gas Inspection Act and lets the president grant certain exemptions.
Clarifies the steps needed to put a device into service and gives the Minister and inspectors new powers, including sampling when meters are examined.
Repeals certain provisions in the Weights and Measures Regulations and the Electricity and Gas Inspection Regulations, and adds transitional rules.
summary.background: The bill amends the Weights and Measures Act and the Electricity and Gas Inspection Act, along with related regulations.
